source.citation: D'Antonio, Xie, Guo. Operational Runbooks as Living Documents: A Longitudinal Study of Document Evolution under Assisted Post-Incident Revision. DocEng '26.

metadata.paper_definition: Lexical markers of obligation, prohibition, and conditional constraint, computed as occurrences per 1,000 words.
metadata.discrepancy: The paper states 28 constraint markers; the printed list transcribed here has 32 distinct entries (the S051 prompt reviews counted 31). The catalog holds the printed list; entry_count is asserted against this transcription, not against the stated 28.
metadata.apostrophes: printed with typographic apostrophes (U+2019); the matcher normalizes U+2019 to U+0027 in text and entries
metadata.transcription: verbatim from the PDF text layer (S051, 2026-09-19); entry order is the printed order
metadata.matching: case-insensitive, word-boundary, longest-match-first non-overlapping over visible Markdown text
